description: Beginning of the Menaion cycle, 10 stichera at Vespers, even on a weekday.

Day of fasting.
Matins: Rite of the Exaltation of the Cross (Not implemented here yet).
Switch to the long scheme of Kathismas (3 at daily Matins, Polyeleos on all Sundays, Kathisma 18 at daily Vespers), starting on the first Sunday after September 21.
Beginning of the Nativity fast.
Switch to the short scheme of Kathismas for the festive season (2 at daily matins, no Polyeleos on Sundays, variable Kathisma at Vespers).
Compline: after this day, the canons are special canons inspired by Holy Week.
Compline: special canons through this day, inclusive. After this, no canons for a while.
1–9 Hours: Royal Hours (if the date falls on a weekend, they are transferred to the preceding Friday).
Vespers with multiple prophecies. If the date does not fall on a weekend, the Liturgy of St. Basil is joined to Vespers.
Great Compline with Lytia.
End of the Nativity fast.
1–9 Hours: Royal Hours (if the date falls on a weekend, they are transferred to the preceding Friday).
Vespers with multiple prophecies, and with the great blessing of the water. If the date does not fall on a weekend, the Liturgy of St. Basil is joined to Vespers.
Great Compline with Lytia.
Switch to the long scheme of Kathismas (3 at daily matins, Polyeleos on all Sundays, Kathisma 18 at daily Vespers) if this date is before the Sunday of the Publican and Pharisee.
Great Compline with Lytia.
End of the Apostles' fast.
Beginning of the Dormition fast.
End of the Dormition fast.
Day of fasting.
